findings.detail: Units are effectively independent iff different decision-code lineage OR parameters from disjoint training data. Same policy code + different deck = 1 policy unit with N correlated deck-units. Decks with multiset-Jaccard>0.5 = same archetype. Seeds/hyperparam jitter alone do not create independence (prereg amendment 3). Sources: /home/admin/gh/fac/PREREG-rq-evaluator-evolution.md nodes 5b/6, /home/admin/gh/AI-Scientist-v2/.fleet-goal/evidence/M3/2026-07-14-p31-league-report.md (18-arm pool), configs/pcmm_r1_portfolio.json.

The 18-arm league pool = 5 frozen bundles (s14, s18, linear, GBM, NN) + 6 heuristic-on-top6-deck arms + 4 diversity slots (decklists PENDING) + off-meta slot (pending harvest) + empty checkpoints pool + reserved exploiter slot. The 6 meta-deck arms run the SAME heuristic policy code as s14-effective (family 1) — a deck-axis stratum, not an independent policy family. s15/s16 lineages are A/A siblings of the heuristic (search never fired; LANE_STATE.md confirmed crash signature). s17/s18 share s14's board_value evaluation inside live search. Honest lineage count: heuristic, live-search, linear-imitation, GBM, transformer-NN, metamon-router, macro-minimax = 7.

findings.detail: heuristic-ref-deck: 1 brain x deck-units {ref, 2c1368bc03, 58f62b5135, 46 PROMOTABLE of 2,857 generated; deck_search.py + ledger verdicts prove production at scale: screened_out 2450, promoted 506, PROMOTABLE 46, reconfirm_out 17}. heuristic-meta-deck: 6 canonical decks = ~4 archetypes (Majkel1337-bono-THIRD cluster Jaccard 0.765/0.875/0.818) + 3 extra field decks (LiamK, nasuo445, Raihan Ramadistra) + 4 diversity decks PENDING decklists + producible off-meta stratum (league_deckrefresh recipe). live-search: 2 configs (s17, s18); further variants = correlated config grid. linear: 3 ckpts (armA/B1/B2) + ~3-4 producible via scripts/policy_imitation.py on disjoint corpus slices. GBM: 1 ckpt + producible (scripts/gbm_imitation.py, arena-1). NN: 1 ckpt + producible (P3.0 trainer, arena-1). metamon-router: 1. macro-minimax: 1. Caveat: linear/GBM/NN all distill the same 76,405-row top-1100 corpus (runs/imitation/imitation_pairs.jsonl) — cross-family teacher correlation; mitigate with disjoint slices per family AND per role.

metamon-router and macro-minimax (1 unit each) cannot fill D_train+D_signal+P_dev+S2, so they cannot be dev families under any split — they must be the S1 sealed pair. Defensible as preregistered taxonomy stratification ('external-algorithm ports'), and their bundles are clean of the dev data path (local pcmm-r1 only, kaggle_submission_allowed=false, not in the ladder replay corpus). Honesty cost: S1 whole-family extrapolation rests on exactly 2 single opponents — the highest-variance stratum just got thinner; the composite-primary weighting (0.5 S1) should be re-examined at prereg level.

linear: D_train=armA, D_signal=armB1, P_dev=armB2, E_gate+S2=3-4 NEW disjoint-slice ckpts. GBM: existing ckpt=D_train; D_signal/P_dev/E_gate/S2 = 3-4 NEW ckpts (arena-1). NN: same as GBM. heur-ref-deck: D_train=ref deck+2c1368bc03, P_dev=58f62b5135, D_signal+E_gate=held-back PROMOTABLE decks (committed pre-training), S2=fresh deck_search RNG stream. heur-meta-deck: D_train=1 deck/archetype (Majkel1337, Yushin Ito, Budew), D_signal=MPGaming, E_gate=LiamK/nasuo445/Raihan, S2=diversity-4+off-meta sample. live-search: D_train=s18, D_signal=s17; E_gate/P_dev/S2 only via correlated config variants — weakest stratum; recommend demoting to S2-only or accepting with stated correlation. P_dev units are fixed and reusable across epochs (P_dev does not evolve); E_gate is the scarce consumable.

E_gate is family-balanced, so K_max = min over dev families of floor(U_Egate/2) (select+confirm unit-disjoint per epoch, no unit reuse ever). Existing units only: K=0 (GBM/NN have zero spare units). After pre-training production (~6 ckpts per trainable family, U_Egate~2-3): K=1. One epoch nullifies 'evolution' — plain PASS is arithmetically impossible. With rotation cross-fitting (unit-disjoint select/confirm within epoch, spacing>=2 epochs between reuses, fresh games every shard, per-unit gate-outcome drift logged as anchor-overfit diagnostic): K=4-6 preregisterable. Deck-rich strata support K>=10 on the deck axis; the min-family bound governs. Games are not the constraint (~25k/hr, C3 READY); units are.

findings.detail: Node 5b text says 'Genome (restricted, preregisterable): 8-family sampling-mass vector' but the lock table (row 5b) and node 6 bind C's genome to the 6 development families ('C's genome therefore spans the 6 development families, not 8'). Must be corrected to 6 (or to the honest post-merge stratum count) before decisive runs — file: /home/admin/gh/fac/PREREG-rq-evaluator-evolution.md lines ~312 vs ~372.

PASS fails on arithmetic (K<=1 strict; two families cannot fill base roles). HARD FAIL is not warranted: amendment 3 explicitly authorizes 'reduce the update count or adopt a preregistered cross-fitting design', production machinery is proven (deck_search at scale; imitation trainers exist), and a concrete preregisterable design is sketched. Conditions: (1) produce and hash-commit 3-4 disjoint-slice checkpoints for each of linear/GBM/NN BEFORE training T0; (2) commit the full unit-role split manifest pre-training; (3) preregister the E_gate unit-rotation schedule with K precommitted (4-6) and the anchor-reuse drift diagnostic; (4) seal metamon-router+macro-minimax as S1 via preregistered taxonomy language; (5) fix the 8-vs-6 genome wording; (6) resolve blockers below.

audit.summary: SPLIT-CAPACITY AUDIT (gate step b) — VERDICT: PASS-WITH-CROSS-FITTING (plain PASS is arithmetically impossible; HARD FAIL is not warranted because the prereg's own amendment-3 escape hatch — reduce update count or preregister cross-fitting — is satisfiable with demonstrated production machinery). Independence criterion used: two opponent units are effectively independent iff they embody different decision-code lineages OR parameters trained on disjoint data; same policy code + different deck = ONE policy unit with deck-units (correlated at the belief/strategy axis); decks with multiset-Jaccard>0.5 = one archetype; random seeds/hyperparam jitter alone = NOT independent (per amendment 3). Under this criterion the "8 families / 14-20 frozen opponents" inventory collapses to SEVEN independent policy lineages: heuristic (s14-effective; also the brain behind the top-6-meta-deck arms AND behind s15/s16 whose search never fired), live determinized search (s17/s18 — 2 configs of one lineage, sharing s14's board_value evaluation function), linear imitation (armA/B1/B2 — 3 checkpoints, one trainer+corpus), GBM imitation (1 ckpt), transformer-BC NN (1 ckpt), metamon-router (1 bundle), macro-minimax (1 bundle) — and all three imitation families distill the SAME 76,405-row top-1100 replay corpus (cross-family correlation via shared teacher population). Units per family after honest counting: heuristic-ref-deck ~unlimited deck-units (2,857 generated, 46 fully-vetted PROMOTABLE, deck_search.py proven at scale) but 1 policy brain; heuristic-meta-deck 6 canonical decks = only ~4 archetypes (Majkel1337/bono/THIRD PTCG Club are one cluster at Jaccard 0.765-0.875) +3 field decks +4 diversity decks PENDING coordinator decklists + producible off-meta stratum; live-search 2 configs; linear 3 ckpts (+3-4 producible on disjoint corpus slices); GBM 1 (+3-4 producible, arena-1 only); NN 1 (+3-4 producible, arena-1 only); metamon-router 1; macro-minimax 1. ROLE-FILL ARITHMETIC: each dev family must fill D_train, D_signal, P_dev, S2 with disjoint units (4 minimum) PLUS 2K one-use E_gate units for K epochs (E_gate units must be disjoint from D_train or d_gate=p_train-p_gate leaks to ~0). Single-unit families (metamon-router, macro-minimax) cannot fill even the 4 base roles → they are FORCED into the S1 sealed pair; this is capacity-forced, must be preregistered as taxonomy-based ("external-algorithm ports" stratum) and honestly flagged — S1 then rests on exactly 2 single opponents (thin, high-variance extrapolation stratum). Because E_gate is family-balanced, K_max = min over dev families: with existing units only K=0; after pre-training production of 3-4 disjoint-slice checkpoints per trainable family K=1 strict (floor(U_E/2) with U_E≈2-3); i.e. THE DESIGN AS LITERALLY SPECIFIED SUPPORTS AT MOST ONE EVALUATOR-UPDATE EPOCH — which nullifies "evolution". With the preregistered cross-fitting design below, K=4-6 is supportable. Feasible role assignment (6 dev strata = heur-ref-deck, heur-meta-deck, live-search, linear, GBM, NN; S1 = metamon-router + macro-minimax quarantined): linear D_train=armA, D_signal=armB1, P_dev=armB2, E_gate+S2=3-4 NEW disjoint-slice ckpts; GBM/NN existing ckpt=D_train, all other roles need NEW production (arena-1); heur-ref-deck splits along vetted-deck axis (D_train=ref+2c1368bc03, P_dev=58f62b5135, D_signal/E_gate=held-back PROMOTABLE decks committed pre-training, S2=fresh deck_search stream); heur-meta-deck D_train=1 deck per archetype (e.g. Majkel1337, Yushin Ito, Budew), D_signal=MPGaming, E_gate=field decks (LiamK/nasuo445/Raihan), S2=diversity-4+off-meta (blocked on decklists); live-search is the weakest stratum (D_train=s18, D_signal=s17, remaining roles only via correlated config-grid variants — recommend demoting it to S2-only or accepting with stated correlation). CROSS-FITTING SKETCH (preregisterable): (1) commit all produced units + role manifest, hashed, BEFORE training; (2) per family, non-train units form a rotation pool; at epoch k, E_gate_select[k] and E_gate_confirm[k] draw unit-disjoint shards, no unit appears in consecutive epochs (spacing >=2), fresh games every shard (games cheap at ~25k/hr; UNITS are the scarce axis); (3) deck-rich strata shard along vetted-deck-cross-seat blocks instead; (4) anchor-reuse honesty: per-unit gate-outcome drift logged as the old-opponent-overfit diagnostic (already in the D-arm attack list); (5) precommit K (recommend 4-6) and shard schedule in the split manifest. Also flagged: prereg internal inconsistency — node 5b says "8-family sampling-mass vector" while the lock table/node 6 bind the genome to the 6 development families; must be corrected to 6 before decisive runs.
